description: This file provides tools for tensor property propagation within the PyTorch JIT compilation framework. It includes functions to apply tensor properties to a Graph's inputs based on example tensors, facilitating type propagation and validation during graph transformations.

methods.name: None apply_input_props_using_example(graph: Graph, example_input: list[Any])
methods.description: Applies tensor property types to the inputs of a given TorchScript Graph based on provided example tensors, with internal checks for input consistency and type matching.
